start:
Hello!

With me you can create PvP-Polls for Pokemon Go in your Telegram group, 
I do respond to the following commands:

/trainername - Sets your trainername. This is useful for players who have a different username in Telegram 
and will replace your Telegram name with the name you set.
Example: /trainername Dexter

/pvp - Creates a PvP-poll. Polls will be deleted automatically after approximately one hour. 
Additionally you can add some more information to your request such as the league or specific rules.
With /language you can change the language of your bot.

If you want to host the bot yourself, feel free to clone this [Github repository](https://github.com/jdanziger/FreshAF-PVPBot).

I hope the bot enhances the PvP experience in your community!
en.poll: is ready to PVP!  Join to battle.
en.dup_poll: A duplicate poll in this chat already exists.
en.adminhelp:
*/version* : Will show the current version of the FreshBot sofware
 */maint* : Will put the bot into maintenance mode
 */floatall* : Float all polls across all chats to the bottom
en.maint:
*Attention:*
Bot undergoing an upgrade. All active polls are being removed. Please wait ~5 minutes and create a new poll to continue. Thanks for your patience.
en.maintwarn:
*Attention:*
Bot undergoing an upgrade. All active polls will be immmediately frozen and removed in 2 minutes. New polls will currently be blocked. Thanks for your patience.
en.pvp_cant_delete: Make sure that the bot has admin rights so it can delete messages
en.group_notice: This can only be done in groups!
en.trainername_length: Your trainername has to be between 4 and 15 characters
en.trainercode_length: Your trainercode must be 12 characters long!
